ac.name: LV AC busway to rack PSUs (415/400 V class)
ac.note: Double-conversion UPS (efficiency from the UPS input) + transformer/busway losses + rack AC→54 V PSU.

dc.name: 800 V DC sidecar power racks
dc.note: Facility rectification / solid-state transformer to 800 V DC, DC busway, rack 800→54 V DC/DC. NVIDIA reports up to ~5% end-to-end efficiency gain and less copper versus 415 V AC.

dynamics.note: Synchronous AI training produces fleet-wide power swings of tens to hundreds of MW at sub-second to second timescales. Grid-forming BESS smoothing is reported to cut the grid-visible swing by roughly 40–60%; combine with GPU power capping and software smoothing.

sources.source: Power Stabilization for AI Training Datacenters (arXiv 2508.14318, preprint)
NVIDIA – How new GB300 NVL72 features provide steady power for AI

mitigations: GPU power capping / frequency locking to limit peak draw and the peak-to-valley swing.
Staggered checkpointing so the whole cluster does not idle and restart in step.
Rack-level power smoothing (energy storage in rack power shelves, ramp-rate limits) where the platform supports it.
Software power floor (keep GPUs at a minimum load during communication and checkpoint phases).
Grid-forming BESS at the point of connection to absorb the remaining oscillation and support ride-through.
Agree ramp-rate, oscillation and fault ride-through limits with the network operator early.
